CustomField.description: For Freight used for auditing to check whether Country Account Manager = Branch Account Manager
CustomField.formula: IF ( AND ( ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Freight-Branch" ) , ISPICKVAL ( Parent.Type , "Freight-Country" ), OwnerId <> Parent.OwnerId , BillingCountry = Parent.BillingCountry ) ,"Different Account Manager","Same Account Manager")
CustomField.label: Account Manager Check
